## How to Add a Reel

1. Find a reel whose script, hook, structure or energy you love
2. Get the transcript (paste directly, use reeltranscript.com, or transcribe manually)
3. Paste it below with the template
4. Tell Script Architect: "Analyse this reel and add it to my swipe file"
5. Claude will run the full forensic analysis and fill in the rest

The more reels you add, the smarter every script becomes.
